$comment: Prompts for optional live runs of the learn skill (see runners/live-compare.md). These are inputs, not outputs: nothing here was generated by running the skill. Each case is a topic × learner level with a mission and three success criteria written as observable outcomes (they become milestones).

cases.mission: I build small React apps from tutorials and want to stop guessing why components re-render.
successCriteria: Predict which components re-render after a given state change in a small component tree
Explain, with a diagram, what happens between setState and the DOM update
Fix one unnecessary re-render in their own app and show the before/after render count

cases.mission: I ship React 19 apps at work and need to reason about rendering performance in code review.
successCriteria: Use the React Profiler to find the costliest render in a real page and name its cause
Choose between memo, useMemo, useCallback and state colocation for a given slowdown and justify it
Explain how concurrent rendering and transitions change what the user sees during a slow update

cases.mission: I want to understand the reconciler well enough to read React's source and debug scheduler issues.
successCriteria: Trace one update through the fiber work loop (render and commit phases) in the React source
Explain lane priorities and predict the order of three updates with different priorities
Build a minimal reconciler that handles keyed list updates and passes a given test set

cases.mission: I use ChatGPT daily and want to know what actually happens inside it.
successCriteria: Explain tokenisation and next-token prediction on a concrete sentence
Compute one attention weight distribution by hand for a 3-token example
Describe what the training objective is and what it is not, in their own words

cases.mission: I fine-tune models with Hugging Face and want to reason about architecture choices.
successCriteria: Implement scaled dot-product attention in NumPy and check it against a reference output
Explain why positional information is needed and compare two positional encoding schemes
Estimate the parameter count and KV-cache memory of a given model configuration

cases.mission: I am preparing to research efficient attention and need a precise model of the full stack.
successCriteria: Derive the computational and memory complexity of multi-head attention and of one efficient variant
Implement a decoder-only transformer block with pre-norm and verify its gradients numerically
Read a recent architecture paper and state precisely which component it changes and why

cases.mission: I am preparing for my first data-structures exam.
successCriteria: Insert and delete keys in a BST by hand and draw the resulting tree
State the BST invariant and check whether a given tree satisfies it
Write in-order traversal and explain why it returns sorted keys

cases.mission: I interview for backend roles and keep failing tree questions.
successCriteria: Implement insert, search and delete (including the two-child case) with tests
Explain why an unbalanced BST degrades to O(n) and construct an input that causes it
Solve two interview problems that rely on the BST invariant within 30 minutes each

cases.mission: I maintain an in-memory index and need to pick and tune a balanced tree.
successCriteria: Implement AVL or red-black rebalancing and prove the height bound informally
Benchmark a balanced tree against a sorted array and a hash map on their own workload
Explain how B-trees adapt the idea to disk pages and when they win

cases.mission: I read A/B test results at work and do not trust my own interpretation.
successCriteria: Compute conditional probabilities from a 2×2 table and spot the base-rate fallacy
Explain what a p-value is and is not, using their own A/B test
Simulate a coin-flip experiment and relate the result to the binomial distribution

cases.mission: I am a data analyst who wants to design experiments properly.
successCriteria: Choose a sample size for an A/B test given a minimum detectable effect and power
Build a bootstrap confidence interval for a metric from their own data
Explain when to use a t-test, a Mann-Whitney test or a permutation test

cases.mission: I am moving into Bayesian modelling for forecasting.
successCriteria: Derive a posterior for a conjugate model and check it by simulation
Fit a hierarchical model to grouped data and explain partial pooling
Run posterior predictive checks and diagnose one model misfit

cases.mission: Sou desenvolvedor júnior e quero entender por que meu app às vezes grava dados inconsistentes.
successCriteria: Explicar o que cada letra de ACID garante usando um exemplo de transferência bancária
Escrever uma transação SQL com COMMIT e ROLLBACK e mostrar o efeito de um erro no meio
Reproduzir uma condição de corrida simples em duas sessões do banco

cases.mission: I build services on PostgreSQL and need to choose isolation levels with confidence.
successCriteria: Reproduce a non-repeatable read and a write skew in PostgreSQL and name the isolation level that prevents each
Explain how MVCC lets readers and writers avoid blocking each other
Fix a lost-update bug in their own code with SELECT … FOR UPDATE or optimistic locking

cases.mission: I am designing a storage engine component and need the theory behind serialisability.
successCriteria: Explain conflict serialisability and test a schedule for it with a precedence graph
Compare two-phase locking with serialisable snapshot isolation on a concrete anomaly
Describe write-ahead logging and recovery (redo/undo) for a crash at a given point

cases.mission: I deploy microservices and want to understand why they fail in strange ways.
successCriteria: Explain partial failure and why a timeout does not tell you whether a request ran
Design an idempotent retry for one of their own API calls
Explain eventual consistency with a concrete read-after-write example

cases.mission: I run a team operating replicated services and need to reason about consistency trade-offs.
successCriteria: Explain CAP and PACELC with a scenario from their own system
Compare leader-based and leaderless replication on availability and consistency
Use vector clocks or version vectors to detect a concurrent write in a toy store

cases.mission: I want to implement consensus to understand production coordination services.
successCriteria: Implement Raft leader election and log replication and pass a provided fault-injection test set
Explain linearisability and check a short history for it by hand
Analyse one published post-mortem and map each failure to a distributed-systems concept
